prompt: How many event days, weekend days and normal days does each month of 2025 have? Use the calendar table and keep the days from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, both included. day_kind is the text 'event' when the day's event is not missing, 'weekend' when the day has no event and is_weekend is true, and 'normal' for every other day. An event on a Saturday or Sunday counts as 'event'. Return three columns, in this order: month_start, day_kind and n_days, the number of days. Return one row per month_start and day_kind combination that has at least one day. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per month and day kind

hints: Next, write the column day_kind with its three branches, count the days, and decide what one row stands for.
Some event days fall on a weekend, and CASE stops at the first true branch, so the event test goes first. A missing event is found with IS NULL or IS NOT NULL. Group by the month and by the day kind.
why_this_works: Testing the event first keeps a weekend event day in the event count, and grouping by month and day kind gives one count per pair.
